Synthetic resource URL capture, 2026-11-09, in a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org on a campaign Dev Hub. The supplied pages evaluate URLFOR on the supplied static resource with ASCII, Latin-1, U+0100, U+20AC and supplementary-character paths at Visualforce source 59.0 and 67.0. The project was deployed separately at each version and each page rendered via PageReference.getContent in execute-anonymous. The href was extracted from the base64-transported HTML and the org host and resource timestamp replaced with {ORGHOST} and {TS}; org.tsv retains those normalized hrefs. Scratch deletion succeeded and the unique description matched exactly one Dev Hub ScratchOrgInfo record with Status Deleted. A preceding attempt contained malformed synthetic page markup and produced no observations; its scratch org was deleted and verified Deleted.
A second fresh 30-day scratch org captured three additional supplementary code points and a prefix/suffix control at 59.0 and 67.0; each emitted the same truncation at the supplementary character. That org was deleted and its unique description verified Status Deleted.
